primary.title: SEBI proposes MF-only PMS with ₹25 lakh entry: Expert explains how it differs from traditional PMS
primary.summary: The proposed MF-only PMS framework is positioned as a bridge between self-managed mutual fund investing and traditional PMS, allowing investors to access professional portfolio management at a lower entry threshold of ₹25 lakh while remaining within regulated investment products.
